name: Seville
scopeLimits: Bounded city-source review only. No citywide completeness is claimed. At most three complete public parcel polygons are retained. No owner or address fields and no credentials or token values are retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Spanish Directorate General for Cadastre publishes the INSPIRE Cadastral Parcel dataset and public WFS/ATOM services. The live WFS advertises the CadastralParcel feature and returned full geometry in Seville at the city locator’s nearby window.
technicalBlocker: Public full parcel geometry is verified, but operational qualification failed: 13 bounded cells returned 326 distinct polygons and the first 120 fresh exact-ID reads matched; a later exact-ID response had inconsistent/incomplete feature counts, followed by HTTP 403 provider blocks. Absence, footprint and source-binding checks could not complete. Runtime remains disabled; failed evidence is retained without retries or modified geometry. Eight sampled overlap pairs above 0.01 m² total only 0.139 m²; this is recorded separately from the access/completeness blocker.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the exact WUP centroid intersects a parcel at finer spatial tolerance, citywide completeness/quality, update consistency, and integration/runtime behavior. The WUP point is a population-weighted settlement locator, not a municipal boundary or parcel identity.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: GetCapabilities HTTP 200 identifies Spanish INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels, WFS 2.0.0. A 20 m x 20 m bbox centered on the WUP point returned HTTP 200 with no records. A 200 m x 200 m bbox returned 104 full geometries despite COUNT=3; three complete features were retained and transformed from declared EPSG:25830 to WGS84 without geometry repair. No personal/address attributes were requested or retained.
